review_candidates.title: Management Analyst
review_candidates.description: Position Objective: The Management Analyst will provide critical operations coordination to the NIAID Executive Officer (EO) who also serves as Deputy Director for Science Management (DDSM) and a senior advisor to the NIAID Deputy Director and the NIAID Director. The services provided include analytical, administrative, and project support for organizational operations for the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases within the National Institutes of Health. Duties And Responsibilities Provides analysis and advisory services regarding management functions. Prepares a variety of management and administrative studies to analyze and evaluate internal procedures, policies, processes and systems for the purpose of improving efficiency. Reviews and comments on new or proposed changes to existing policies, procedures or systems. Prepare reports in the areas of budget, procurement, HR, travel, etc. Reviews policy and regulation that governs the activities performed in the program. Prepare reports and presentations for meetings. Research and suggests developing areas of management policy. Performs in-depth analysis and statistical comparison of organizational data and information. Assist financial managers prepare annual appropriate budget requests. Conduct workforce studies and provide in-depth analysis and reporting Provide senior-level meeting and executive support to the Office of the Director (OD), independently performing complex administrative and coordination functions to relieve OD leadership of administrative burdens and enable focus on executive-level responsibilities. Manage administrative operations for OD leadership, ensuring efficient workflow, prioritization of executive activities, and proactive anticipation of leadership needs. Serve as a trusted resource to OD leadership, handling sensitive and time-critical matters with a high degree of discretion and professionalism. Prepare, edit, and finalize routine and advanced correspondence, including letters, presentation materials, memoranda, reports, and briefing materials. Synthesize information from multiple sources to develop clear, executive-level responses to inquiries from senior officials and stakeholders. Manage and facilitate communications on behalf of OD leadership, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities. Oversee and manage complex executive calendars, independently resolving conflicts and aligning schedules with strategic priorities Evaluate and prioritize meeting requests, exercising judgment on urgency, importance, and relevance. Coordinate high-level meetings involving senior government officials and external partners. Handle a wide variety of administrative and operational situations, including resolving conflicts related to scheduling, resources, and office coordination. Identify potential issues and implement solutions with minimal guidance. Track and follow up on action items, ensuring timely completion of leadership priorities including project status reports, dashboards, and executive briefings. Plan, coordinate, and execute logistics for executive-level meetings, briefings, and events (virtual and in-person), including space, technology, and materials. Attend meetings as required to capture key decisions, discussion points, and action items. Prepare and distribute briefing materials and ensure proper documentation and centralized recordkeeping. Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process documentation. Conduct advanced internet and database research to support leadership requests and program needs. Compile, analyze, and present data in formats suitable for executive decision-making. Support data-driven decision-making using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Assist with planning, coordinating, and tracking projects and program activities and monitor project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and risks. Coordinate responses to internal and external data calls, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness. Support budget planning and tracking activities in coordination with Administrative Officers (AOs) and program staff. Assist in monitoring expenditures and preparing financial documentation and reports and assist with resource planning and forecasting. Prepare and process administrative actions such as procurement requests, training requests, and related documentation. Prepare analytical reports and recommendations. Support program evaluations and organizational studies. Manage end-to-end travel coordination for leadership and staff, including authorizations, vouchers, travel orders, and registrations. Ensure compliance with federal travel regulations and agency-specific policies. Maintain organized systems for document storage and retrieval (e.g., SharePoint, NIH Box), ensuring accessibility and compliance with records management policies. Ensure proper handling and safeguarding of confidential and sensitive information. Maintain project documentation and records. Develop reports, manuals, and user guides. Ensure documentation complies with records management requirements. Organize electronic files and document repositories. Support documentation management for program operations and compliance requirements. Oversee administrative processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Develop and implement improved workflows and incorporate new tools, technologies, and best practices. Track office inventory and coordinate procurement of supplies and equipment. Develop, format, and review a wide range of documents, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to organizational standards. Independently prepare and format presentations, reports, and spreadsheets using advanced software tools (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Integrate and reconcile edits from multiple stakeholders using document management tools (e.g., track changes). Assist in the collection, compilation, and dissemination of scientific and programmatic information relevant to OD priorities. Maintain awareness of ongoing initiatives, deadlines, and action items to ensure OD leadership is informed of critical developments. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders. Respond to information requests. Support customer service and communication initiatives.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your knowledge makes a real difference. review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Developer
review_candidates.description: Opentext - The Information Company OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation. AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered. At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us. The Content Services business unit provides content platforms used by thousands of organizations to manage business content on-premise, in public cloud and private cloud, across a diverse portfolio of mature and emerging products. We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to design and build the integration layer between OpenText Content Management and the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 productivity services. You will develop SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions, Office add-ins, and Microsoft Graph and REST API integrations that enable thousands of enterprise users to seamlessly access, manage, and govern content directly within the applications they use every day. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role on a small, high-impact team with significant visibility across the organization. You will own features end-to-end, from architecture and design through implementation, testing, release, and post-production support. Working closely with Product Management, QA, Support, and Cloud Operations teams across multiple geographies, you will help deliver reliable, scalable, and intuitive integrations that are critical to our clients' daily workflows. Your Impact The integrations you build are often the first experience clients have with our platform. When a records manager can securely file an email to a governed repository without leaving Outlook, or a project team can access controlled content directly within a Microsoft Teams channel, that experience is the result of your work. You will solve complex challenges that span two large enterprise ecosystems: OpenText and Microsoft. Success often requires going beyond the documentation, analyzing protocol traces, understanding authentication and token flows, and collaborating directly with clients to diagnose and reproduce issues. This is a role for a developer who enjoys tackling difficult integration problems, navigating ambiguity, and delivering solutions that have a direct impact on client productivity and adoption. What The Role Offers As a Senior Software Developer, you will: Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Framework (SPFx) web parts and extensions, Microsoft Teams applications, and Outlook add-ins that bring Content Management capabilities directly into the Microsoft 365 experience. Develop and maintain integrations with Microsoft Graph and REST APIs across SharePoint, Teams, Exchange/Outlook, and related Microsoft 365 services, including bidirectional synchronization of content and metadata. Build cloud-native back-end services on Azure using Azure Functions, Storage, Service Bus, and API Management, leveraging event-driven architectures and asynchronous messaging patterns to deliver scalable and resilient integrations. Implement, secure, and troubleshoot end-to-end authentication and authorization solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID app registrations, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows, JWT validation, consent and permission management, credential rotation, and cross-tenant single sign-on. Design relational data models and develop high-performance SQL Server solutions, including schema design, indexing strategies, query tuning, and optimization for large-scale workloads. Diagnose and resolve complex integration challenges across Microsoft 365, Azure, browsers, and third-party platforms, including CORS restrictions, throttling behavior, tenant configuration differences, dependency failures, and platform version changes. Partner with Support and Professional Services teams to investigate client escalations, reproduce reported issues, communicate actionable findings, and translate root-cause analysis into product and operational improvements. Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture reviews, maintain high-quality technical documentation, and elevate engineering excellence through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship. Collaborate with an Agile development team alongside Product Management and Quality Assurance to refine requirements, estimate work, and deliver high-quality releases on schedule. What You Need To Succeed Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, with 6+ years of professional software development experience. Strong object-oriented development expertise in C# and .NET, with a solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and software engineering best practices for building clean, maintainable, and testable code. Strong front-end development skills using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands-on experience developing SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions. Demonstrated experience integrating with Microsoft Graph and REST APIs across Microsoft 365 services, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and related workloads. Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, Storage, Service Bus, and API Management, in production environments. Practical experience implementing modern identity and access management solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, and Single Sign-On (SSO), including application registration, consent management, and delegated versus application permission models. Strong SQL and relational database design skills, with experience developing and optimizing solutions on Microsoft SQL Server or equivalent RDBMS platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts effectively to clients, support teams, and software developers at the appropriate level of detail. Experience working within Agile development teams in cross-functional, geographically distributed environments. Experience with Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Content Services, or Information Management platforms, including concepts such as records management, retention policies, information governance, classification, and compliance. Familiarity with modern containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes, as well as scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Demonstrated proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code), including the judgment to critically review, validate, test, and maintain generated code before production deployment. One Last Thing OpenText is more than a corporation—it’s a global community built on trust, character, and purpose. Here, we act ethically, care deeply about people, and always put our clients first. We help teams succeed through collaboration, tackle challenges with resilience, and innovate with intention. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and teamwork. At OpenText, we don’t just have a culture—we live our values. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that empowers you to make a meaningful impact. OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace. Compensation: At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off. Salary Range: $98,080.00 - $147,120.00; Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted. AI Usage Disclosure: As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

review_candidates.title: NetSuite Engineer
review_candidates.description: Position Description As a NetSuite Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining a global, multi subsidiary NetSuite ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technology advisor to internal stakeholders while acting as a hands on lead developer supporting NetSuite solutions and customizations. In this role, you will oversee the broader e commerce and integration landscape, including iPaaS connections with storefronts, payment processors, banking platforms, accounting systems, and tax engines. You will ensure NetSuite is strategically aligned to the company's business objectives and technology roadmap, maximizing the platform's value across the organization. You will work closely with business units and cross functional technical teams to deliver scalable B2C and B2B solutions. Additionally, you will define and communicate a strategic vision for the use of NetSuite across the enterprise, driving innovation and measurable value for the business and its clients. This position is located at the client site in Alexandria, VA; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable. Your future duties and responsibilities Leads discovery sessions with clients, and merchant partners to capture requirements and architect scalable solutions. Leading role as NetSuite ERP solutions architect. Ability to lead and deliver end to end solutions alongside a team of engineers. Integral team member alongside NetSuite engineers, functional SMEs, and business analysis. Execute development requirements outlined in statement of work, technical requirements or user stories. Build relationships with clients to deliver successful projects on time and on budget. Participates in Scrum Agile development methodologies. Stay updated on new products and technologies including core NetSuite and e commerce. Configures and customizes NetSuite Solutions and Integrations for B2C and B2B architecture to fit current client ecosystem. Educates internal and external audiences on NetSuite best practices. Partners with clients on strategic roadmap with NetSuite as the ERP and center of business operations. Expected to collaborate with other cross functional teams in integration needs with Adobe AEM, Adobe Commerce, Events Platforms, CRM, CDP, and Data warehouse. Works alongside e commerce, finance and accounting teams on NetSuite integrations, configurations, and customizations. Conducts business process mapping and requirements gathering sessions with clients. Preparation of scope documents resulting from prospects/clients' requirements gathering sessions. Problem solving skills to assess and troubleshoot issues that arise during application configurations, workflows, and scripting. Ensures information security protocols and practices are in place to protect unauthorized access and use of corporate data. Help service delivery teams to ensure the agreed upon targets and standards are met. Identifies and recommends opportunities to enhance productivity, effectiveness, and operational efficiencies for clients. Effectively and proactively communicates risks to management and assists with the development of viable solutions to mitigate risk. Ability to work in a hectic, fast paced organization, and filled with high pressure situations daily. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role 5+ direct full life cycle NetSuite implementation+, upgrades, and support experience. 5+ years of developing and supporting e commerce software solutions with NetSuite as the ERP. 5+ years' experience with API (Soap, Rest) development and integration. 3+ years of hands on experience in NetSuite administration, configuration, and customization. 3+ years' experience with iPaaS Systems (MuleSoft, Celigo, Jitterbit, Boomi). In depth knowledge of years of NetSuite modules, including Finance, Banking, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory. Experience with workflows, user events, saves searches, scheduled scripts and map reduce scripts. Experience with SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, and SuiteAnalytics is a plus. Experience with custom implementation and JavaScript frameworks such as Backbone.js, React.js, Node.js. Ability to lead functional and technical workshops including documenting requirements and use cases. Experience with NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Framework (SDF). Experience with SuiteScript (1.0, 2.0), SuiteTalk, SuiteFlow, Integrations, and Reporting. Experience with data conversions, migrations, interfaces/integrations, reporting, and customizations to NetSuite applications. Experience working in a global business environment. Preferred NetSuite SuiteFoundation, Application Developer, Web Services Developer, ERP Consultant Certifications. Excellent problem solving, analytical, and project management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with both technical and non technical stakeholders. Other Information: CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors not limited to skill set, level, experience, relevant training, and licensure and certifications. To support the ability to reward for merit based performance, CGI typically does not hire individuals at or near the top of the range for their role. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for this role in the U.S. is $124,700.00 to $218,200.00. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. What you will do: Development of new software to meet business requirements Monitoring and configuration of deployed applications Maintenance of deployed applications according to necessary changes Preparation of development documentation, engagement in operation manuals and/or training materials as needed Perform software techniques such as test driven development in delivering and maintaining working software Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, QA/application specialists and DevOps and other IT functions Participate in interesting projects and innovations that help company grow May train/mentor junior staff May lead teams or projects with broad visibility Participate on interesting projects and innovations that help company grow Become a recognized team member in a friendly and agile environment What you need to have Minimum 7+ years' experience in a Full Stack Developer role. Experience working in financial business is a plus Senior level knowledge in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Maven, REST API, Kafka streaming, Docker, can work without guidance. Senior level knowledge in Web Programming (Angular), can work without guidance. Strong in technical design of the end-to-end solution across different teams. Strong in microservice architecture and application architecture Working knowledge of database design and SQL (preferably Oracle) Working knowledge of Gitlab Working knowledge of basic security and networking Basic knowledge of Python Actively using UML diagrams, flowcharts, process maps, etc.) Ability to write in both technical and user-friendly language. Working proficiency in Programming Aptitude (language independent) Working knowledge in spring framework and spring boots Working knowledge Shell (Linux/Windows) Familiarity in UI/UX is a plus Familiarity in Build tools (e.g., Composer/NPM, Webpack) Familiarity in Specialized framework (e.g., Laravel/Vue.js) Familiarity in RESTful API Familiarity in Reactive programming, Asynchronous, Prototyping (proof of concept) Familiarity with Git/Version Control/Repository What can set you apart: Familiarity of Lambda expressions and microservice architecture Familiarity of messaging service (e.g. JMS, Rabbit MQ, Kafka) and big data platform (e.g. Hadoop) Familiarity of basic security and networking Familiarity of AI/Robotics/Automation and Cloud Computing Job Perks You’ll Enjoy: Hybrid work setup Permanent dayshift schedule Up to 20% variable performance-based bonus HMO on Day 1 and HMO dependents coverage including same-sex partners Access to mental health and wellness partners Wellness Leaves and Birthday Leave Internal career mobility options Local and international learning opportunities Empower Filipinos with innovative financial solutions at Home Credit Philippines. review_candidates.title: Associate Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do. At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful. When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives. Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world. Job Description: About the Role: Associate Software Engineer - .NET Join the Platforms and Engineering group and help shape the future of Sun Life's technology. We're looking for a talented Associate Software Engineer- .NET to own meaningful projects that drive real impact for our clients' financial security and wellbeing. You will have genuine autonomy to innovate and bring your creative ideas to life within an Agile environment that values fast learning and iterative improvement. What Makes This Different? You'll work in an environment where you're empowered to experiment, fail fast and iterate toward excellence. We value creative thinking and give you real ownership over the impact you deliver. What will you do? Own end-to-end solutions - Collaborate with designers, business analysts, and testing specialists to design and deliver high-quality applications that solve real client problems. Modernize legacy systems - Evaluate and upgrade existing applications to adopt current technologies and frameworks to reduce technical debt. Bridge teams seamlessly - Coordinate with onshore and offshore teams to ensure excellence across development, testing, and implementation. Champion quality and security - Embed information security standards into every solution you build while maintaining application performance and stability in production environments. Lead through problem-solving - Take ownership of incident analysis, resolution, and performance optimization; escalate strategically when needed. What do you need to succeed? Core Requirements: Minimum of 1 year professional IT experience in Agile-based application development. Proficiency with C#, .NET, ASP.NET, REST API, SOAP-based web services. Proficiency with SQL, SQL Server knowledge, relational database concept. Familiarity with CI/DevOps tools (TFS, Git, Artifactory, NuGet) and unit test automation. Familiarity with modern development tools including GenAI and Copilot. Bonus Qualifications: Financial services or insurance industry background. Experience with Java. Additional Requirements: Participate in rotating on-call support for production environments. Participate in periodic weekend / after-hours work to support project implementations and system upgrades. Flexibility for occasional after-hours work and periodic travel between Sun Life locations. Unique Requirements: This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. What’s in it for you? Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. An environment of continuous learning, development, and improvement. Internal mobility is supported by leaders who are dedicated to fueling your professional growth. As a hybrid organization, you and your leader use business and Client needs to choose where you work, at home or in the office. The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com. We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you. We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling. We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Salary Range: 54,000/54 000 - 89,000/89 000 Job Category: IT - Application Development Posting End Date: 11/09/2026
